Schedules.name: Museum open
Schedules.notes: Disabled example: open at 10:00 Tuesday to Sunday, except Christmas Day.

Schedules.name: Museum close
Schedules.notes: Disabled example: close at 17:00 Tuesday to Sunday.

Schedules.name: Song Book start
Schedules.notes: Plays the 'Kuarna Song Book' playlist saved in the dashboard's Media Player tab. The argument IS the playlist name - rename the playlist in the Media Player tab and this must be updated to match. Reaches the mpv engine via LTL-LIB-MEDIA-SCHEDULE. Left disabled on this dev host; tick Enabled on site.

Schedules.name: Song Book stop
Schedules.notes: Stops mpv at end of day. No argument. Without this the playlist keeps looping after hours.
